ceo_anna: Thanks for joining today Short recap: we announced the new SLO playbook initiative, tightened default data retention for trials, and highlighted the Dedicated beta expansion. Links + actions below.

mike: slides + short recording: https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/2123456789-summary.pdf and https://redwood.cloud/recordings/2123456789.mp4

lina: quick Q: retention change affects trial orgs only or also paid customers by default?

jamie: trials default to 14d for non-PII; paid customers remain at contract defaults unless they opt-in to the new shorter default. legal published details in the policy doc.

infra_bot: Transcript and captions: https://redwood.cloud/transcripts/2123456789.txt

mike: Dedicated beta: were opening 50 more seats next week. ops will send invites; early partners will get region pinning.

lina: can product post a tiny blurb for marketing? 2 bullets and a screenshot suffice.

ceo_anna: @mike please work with marketing. Also: everyone nominate one rep for the SLO playbook working groups by Friday.

jamie: added a follow-ups doc with owners: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/2123456789-followups. I put tentative dates for the playbook kickoff.

ceo_anna: appreciate the speed. we'll do a short sync in #product next Tue with updates. If anything urgent, drop it here.
